title: Ladakhi language
description: Tibetic language spoken in Ladakh, India
extract: The Ladakhi language is a Tibetic language spoken in the Indian union territory of Ladakh. It is the predominant language in the Buddhist-dominated district of Leh, and a minority language in the district of Kargil.
